**Why this command reveals them:**
By default, `fd` automatically looks for and respects `

.gitignore`, `.ignore`, and `.fdignore` files in the directory tree, hiding paths matched by those ignore patterns (e.g., `target/`, `ignored_module.rs`, `secret_token.rs`). The `-I` (or `--no-ignore` / `--no-ignore-vcs`) flag disables parsing and enforcing ignore files, allowing `fd` to traverse and print all otherwise ignored paths.
